_note: Your company Genie Agents. Synthetic data for the show-and-tell. validation_status must be set to validated_read_only before an item is added to an agent.

agents.description: Gross margin, net revenue, price and discount leakage by category, branch and customer.
text_instructions: Use MEASURE() for every measure in vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.mv_revenue_margin; do not sum raw amounts.
Gross Margin Pct is Gross Margin divided by Net Revenue. Gross Margin vs Plan Bps is negative when margin is below plan.
Product Category comes from the product dimension; Fasteners is one category.
Default period is the latest closed week (Order Week) unless the user names one.
Discount Leakage is the discount value on actual lines; rank accounts by it for leakage questions.
sample_questions: What was our gross margin last week compared with plan?
Which product categories are below plan on margin?
Show the top 20 customers by discount leakage this quarter
How much net revenue did Fasteners make last month?

example_sql.question: Gross margin vs plan by product category, latest week
example_sql.sql: SELECT `Product Category`, MEASURE(`Gross Margin Pct`) AS gm_pct, MEASURE(`Gross Margin vs Plan Bps`) AS gm_vs_plan_bps FROM vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.mv_revenue_margin WHERE `Order Week` = DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', date_sub(current_date(), 7)) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY gm_vs_plan_bps

example_sql.question: Discount leakage by customer, top 20, last quarter
example_sql.sql: SELECT `Customer Name`, MEASURE(`Discount Leakage`) AS discount_leakage FROM vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.mv_revenue_margin WHERE `Order Date` >= ADD_MONTHS(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', current_date()), -3) AND `Order Date` < DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', current_date()) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY discount_leakage DESC LIMIT 20

benchmarks.question: What is gross margin vs plan in basis points for the Fasteners category in the latest closed week?
benchmarks.expected_sql: SELECT MEASURE(`Gross Margin vs Plan Bps`) FROM vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.mv_revenue_margin WHERE `Product Category` = 'Fasteners' AND `Order Week` = '<latest closed week>' GROUP BY ALL
benchmarks.evaluation_note: Must use the measure, not a hand-computed margin. Must name the category and period.

benchmarks.question: What were total net revenue and gross margin percent for the latest closed week?
benchmarks.expected_sql: SELECT MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), MEASURE(`Gross Margin Pct`) FROM vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.mv_revenue_margin WHERE `Order Week` = '<latest closed week>' GROUP BY ALL
benchmarks.evaluation_note: Both figures from the same week; margin percent is not recomputed from rounded revenue.

agents.description: DSO, open receivables, collections-risk exposure and inventory ageing.
text_instructions: Use MEASURE() for every measure in the working-capital and inventory-ageing views.
DSO Days is the working-capital measure; show it beside the 42-day target, never inside the measure.
Collections Risk Exposure is open AR on invoices the collections-risk model flags HIGH; it is not a bad-debt provision.
Inventory Over 180 Days is the value of stock aged more than 180 days.
sample_questions: What is our DSO this month against the 42 day target?
How much receivables are at collections risk?
How much inventory is older than 180 days?

example_sql.question: DSO days and collections risk exposure, latest month
example_sql.sql: SELECT MEASURE(`DSO Days`) AS dso_days, MEASURE(`Collections Risk Exposure`) AS collections_risk FROM vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.mv_working_capital WHERE `Invoice Month` = DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', current_date()) GROUP BY ALL

benchmarks.question: What is DSO and how does it compare with the 42 day target?
benchmarks.expected_sql: SELECT MEASURE(`DSO Days`) FROM vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.mv_working_capital WHERE `Invoice Month` = '<latest closed month>' GROUP BY ALL
benchmarks.evaluation_note: Agent must state the target comparison in words, not only the number.

benchmarks.question: How much receivables are at collections risk and how much inventory is over 180 days old?
benchmarks.expected_sql: SELECT (SELECT MEASURE(`Collections Risk Exposure`) FROM vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.mv_working_capital) AS collections_risk, (SELECT MEASURE(`Inventory Over 180 Days`) FROM vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.mv_inventory_ageing) AS inventory_over_180
benchmarks.evaluation_note: Multi-view question. Answer must name both views and keep the two figures separate.
